【原视频简介】
Why can an I-beam carry enormous loads while using surprisingly little steel?

In this video, we look inside an I-beam to understand what happens when a beam bends, why the flanges are positioned so far apart, what the web actually does, and how engineers use geometry to create strong, efficient structures. We’ll also look at the limits of I-beams and why their dimensions have to be carefully designed.
